facts.value: With a background in architecture that spans disciplines, you’ll graduate prepared for a variety of career trajectories. You can seek roles as an architectural intern, interior or industrial designer, graphic designer and more. If you want to become a licensed architect, this program will equip you to pursue graduate studies in the field.
